mutants.description: An overcurrent window trip in S_RUN re-ramps straight into S_SS instead of first serving the S_HICCUP cool-down
mutants.reason: When window_trip asserts in S_RUN, the next state is S_SS. ss_active rises instead of hiccup_active, and en stays high, so the converter keeps switching with no cool-down.

mutants.description: At the end of the cool-down S_HICCUP returns to S_OFF and relies on S_OFF to restart, instead of retrying directly into S_SS
mutants.reason: After hiccup_done, state_out shows S_OFF for one clock and ss_active/en rise a clock late. hiccup_active falls without ss_active rising on the same edge.

mutants.description: hiccup_active is decoded from next_state, so it leads the registered S_HICCUP state by one clock
mutants.reason: hiccup_active rises on the same clock that window_trip or window_trip_SS asserts, while state_out still shows S_RUN or S_SS. It falls on the hiccup_done clock, a clock before the state leaves S_HICCUP.

mutants.description: run_active is taken as 'regulating and gate drive on', so the combinational fault gating of en also drops it
mutants.reason: In S_RUN, when OTP, UVLO, latch_state, latch_assert or loss of g_en asserts, run_active falls on the same clock. In the original it falls on the next clock, with state_out still showing S_RUN in between.

mutants.description: hiccup_active is decoded as 'power stage held off by the state', so it is also high in S_OFF
mutants.reason: Out of reset and whenever the FSM sits in S_OFF, hiccup_active is high although the state is not S_HICCUP. This starts the hiccup timer and strike counter while the converter is off.

mutants.description: The overcurrent window trips are treated as hard fault inputs in the combinational gating of en
mutants.reason: On the clock where window_trip (in S_RUN) or window_trip_SS (in S_SS) asserts, en goes low while the state is still S_RUN or S_SS. In the original, en stays high until S_HICCUP registers.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
after: if (~en_SW | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
mutants.description: In S_RUN only the physical switch is checked for disable: a host disable over SPI gates en but does not send the FSM to S_OFF
mutants.reason: If spi_enable drops in S_RUN with en_SW high, en goes low but state stays S_RUN and run_active stays high. When spi_enable returns, en comes straight back at full duty without the S_SS re-ramp.
